title: Ruthless EZ DUZ IT On Ice Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Ez Duz It On Ice by Ruthless is a refreshingly cool twist on the original fan-favourite flavour. Juicy, sun-ripened Strawberries and lush, sweet Watermelon are perfectly balanced with an invigorating burst of menthol, creating a vape that’s both fruity and chillingly smooth. Each puff delivers an icy exhale that enhances the bold fruit notes while keeping the overall profile clean and refreshing. One of many incredible flavours found in the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill collection, Ez Duz It On Ice features a 70VG/30PG ratio, designed to deliver thick vapour and full-bodied flavour with a smooth inhale. Optimised for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, this e-liquid is supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, giving vapers the flexibility to customise their nicotine strength. Ruthless is one of the pioneers of American e-liquids, famous for crafting bold, trend-setting blends that continue to shape the industry. Their expertly crafted shortfills remain a top choice for vapers seeking high-quality, memorable flavour experiences.
